died.name: Giacomo Casanova
died.last_words: I have lived as a philosopher. I die as a Christian.

died.name: James Lawrence
died.cause: mortally wounded by British fire. His words became a popular naval battle cry
died.last_words: Don't give up the ship. Fight her till she sinks.

died.name: Antonio José de Sucre
died.desc: Venezuelan independence leader and President of Peru and Bolivia
died.cause: after being shot while riding in the jungle of Colombia. He was said to be an educated gentleman who had never cursed until that day

died.name: Frank Hayes
died.cause: The 22-year-old Irish jockey died of a heart attack mid-race in Elmont, New York, and collapsed on the horse, which nonetheless crossed the finish line first, still carrying his body.

died.name: Wilhelm II
died.cause: dying of a pulmonary embolism at Huis Doorn
died.last_words: It's coming to an end for me, I'm sinking, I'm sinking!

born.name: John Scott, 1st Earl of Eldon
born.last_words: It matters not where I am going whether the weather be cold or hot.

born.last_words: Nothing succeeds with me. Even here, I meet with disappointment.

born.name: Tsuyoshi Inukai
born.last_words: ″Well, wait, you'll understand once we talk. It's day, you need not shoot me.″

born.name: Arthur Barker

born.name: Victor Prather
born.cause: The 34-year-old U.S. Navy flight surgeon drowned at the end of the record-setting Strato-Lab V balloon flight when he slipped from the rescue sling during recovery operations in the Gulf of Mexico and his pressure suit filled with water.
